author: G-Wizz48
quote: The game has a decent amount of bugs, feels heavy and slow and the worst thing is, that it doesnt feel like a gta. The worst thing is, that you get punished for being a ruthless killer. If u get punished for being criminal, the game is no gta for me. The driving is also to heavy and realistic to have fun. It should still be a videogame. Things like bad plane and train physics are also I thing. Also the ending of the already boring story is terrible. Its dying or prison and if you played the game like a normal gta you can only get the "bad" ending. Absolutely slop ****.
